# 1. Patch
## Grid Bota (all Metric)

```{r}
# Config
basic_config <- list(
  Level = "Family",
  Name = "Fabaceae",
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10)

# No filters
grid_filters <- list()

# All metric
all_metrics <- c("Count","NCI","Basal_Area_m2","OTU","Shannon","H1")

# All plots
all_plots <- list()

for (m in all_metrics) {
  grid_config <- basic_config
  grid_config$Metric <- m
  
  # Grid Read
  grid <- grid_read(
    config = grid_config,
    filters = grid_filters
  )
  
  # Plot
  all_plots[[m]] <- plot_grid(grid)
  
}

Wrap <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 3) + 
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste0("Toutes les Metrics pour l'inventaire :  ", 
                   basic_config$Type, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Level, " / ", 
                   basic_config$Name, " / R = ", 
                   basic_config$Radius
                   )
    )


```

## Abiotic Pannel

```{r}

# Import
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(x,y))

# Abiotic variables
abiotic_vars <- colnames(abiotic) 

# Plot list
plot_list <- list()

# Plot loop
for(i in 1:length(abiotic_vars)){
  
  # Metric
  metric <- abiotic_vars[[i]]
  print(metric)
  
  # Config
  config <- list(
    Type = "abiotic",
    Metric = metric)
  
  # Grid
  grid <- grid_read(config)
  
  # Plot
  plot_list[[i]] <- plot_grid(grid) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(caption = grid$config$Name) +
    theme(
      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,   # centré
        size = 9,
        face = "bold.italic"
      )
    )
  
}

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 10)

```

## Botanical Model (Count,NCI,I/O)

```{r}

# Configurations
bota_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = c("Presence", "Count"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 20)

nci_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = c("NCI"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 20,
  Alpha = 1.5,
  Beta = 0.1)

genet_conf <- list(  
  Type = "genet",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = "Reads",
  Rar = TRUE,
  Marker = c("GH"))

config_tab <- bind_rows(list(bota_conf, nci_conf, genet_conf))

# Generate grids
grid_list <- build_grids(config_tab)

titles <- list(
  "Presence / Absence",
  "Count (R=20)",
  expression(bold(NCI~"("~alpha==1.5*","~beta==0.1~")")),
  "GH Reads"
)

# Generate plots
plot_list <- Map(function(grid, title){
  plot_grid(grid, stems = TRUE) +
    labs(title = title)
}, grid_list, titles)

# Wrap
wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4)

```

  BA  = df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[9]]
)

# Combine dataframes

  imap(~ rename(.x, !!.y := Metric)) %>%   # renomme Metric avec le nom de la liste

  geom_point() +

# I. TAXONOMY DETECTION

## 1. Intersection table (To Fix)

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(UpSetR)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Datasets
# --------------------------------------------------

config_tab <- expand.grid(
  "Marker" = c("Bota","GH","ITS","18S","REF"),
  "Level" = c("Family","Genus","Species"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Fill community composition
# --------------------------------------------------

config_tab$Ab_tib <- map2(
  config_tab$Level,
  config_tab$Marker,
  get_ab_tib
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Split by level
# --------------------------------------------------

list_by_level <- config_tab %>%
  split(.$Level) %>%
  map(~ setNames(.x$Ab_tib, .x$Marker))

# --------------------------------------------------
# Clean lists
# --------------------------------------------------

list_by_level_clean <- map(
  list_by_level,
  ~ map(.x, extract_names) %>%
      map(clean_names)
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Plots
# --------------------------------------------------

# Size of total numbers
set_size <- list("Family"=200, "Genus"=600, "Species"=1600)

# List of plots : Family, Genus, Species
plot_list <- lapply(names(list_by_level_clean), function(lvl){
  data_upset <- fromList(list_by_level_clean[[lvl]])
  
  upset(data_upset,
        nsets = ncol(data_upset),
        order.by = "freq",
        show.numbers = "yes",
        set_size.show = TRUE,
        main.bar.color = "steelblue",
        sets.bar.color = "gray",
        mainbar.y.label = paste("Intersections -", lvl),
        sets.x.label = "Set Size",
        set_size.scale_max = set_size[[lvl]])
})


```

## 4. RICHNESS and GROWTH

### A. Main figure

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# LOAD
# --------------------------------------------------

load("~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.ab_rel_OTU.RData",
  envir = .GlobalEnv)

# --------------------------------------------------
# COMBINE <2%
# --------------------------------------------------

df_reduced <- df_ab_rel_Richness

df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% percent_other("Clade", "Metric", 2)
  })

# Liste des indices correspondant aux différentes sources
source_indices <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7)
source_names <- c( "GH","GH", "ITS","ITS", "18S","18S", "Bota")

# Appliquer une fonction à chaque élément de la liste df_reduced$Result
df_list <- lapply(seq_along(source_indices), function(i) {
  # Extraire le dataframe correspondant
  df_temp <- df_reduced$Result[[source_indices[i]]]
  
  # Ajouter la colonne Source
  df_temp$Source <- source_names[i]
  
  return(df_temp)
})

# --------------------------------------------------
# MAKE FAMILIES REFERENCE
# --------------------------------------------------

# All families
all_fam <-  bind_rows(df_list[c(2,4,6,7)]) %>% 
  pull(Clade) %>%
  unique()

# Bota families
bota_fam <- df_list[7][[1]]$Clade

# Genet families
gen_fam <- bind_rows(df_list[c(2,4,6)]) %>% 
  pull(Clade) %>%
  unique()

# Family reference with labels color
all_fam_df <- data.frame(
  family = all_fam,
  Clade = all_fam,
  in_bota = all_fam %in% bota_fam & !all_fam %in% gen_fam,
  in_genet = all_fam %in% gen_fam & !all_fam %in% bota_fam,
  in_both = all_fam %in% bota_fam & all_fam %in% gen_fam
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# ABUNDANCE
# --------------------------------------------------

# Select
df_plot_rar <- bind_rows(df_list[c(2, 4, 6, 7)]) %>%
  left_join(all_fam_df, by = "Clade")

# Plot
p1 <- ab_rel_plot(df_plot_rar)

# --------------------------------------------------
# GROWTH TYPE
# --------------------------------------------------

# Select
growth_form <- growth_form_family(all_fam_df)

# Plot
p2 <- growth_form_plot(growth_form)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

(p1 | p2)

```

### B. Annexe Table

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# LOAD
# --------------------------------------------------

load("~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.ab_rel_OTU.RData",
  envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Copy
df_reduced <- df_ab_rel_Richness

# --------------------------------------------------
# MODIFY
# --------------------------------------------------

# Annotate
df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% 
    mutate(Metric = round(Metric, digits = 2)) %>%
    mutate( `<2%` = ifelse(Metric < 2 ,TRUE ,FALSE)) %>%
    mutate( `<0.05%` = ifelse(Metric < 0.05 ,TRUE ,FALSE))
  })

# Classify
source_names <- c( "GH","GH", "ITS","ITS", "18S","18S", "Bota")

df_list <- lapply(1:7, function(i) {
  
  df <- df_reduced$Result[[i]] # Select
  
  df$Source <- source_names[i] # Ajouter la colonne Source
  
  return(df)
})

# Combine
df_plot_rar <-  bind_rows(df_list[c(2,4,6,7)]) %>%
  mutate( in_bota = Clade %in% df_list[7][[1]]$Clade) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Metric < 0.5)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------
ab_rel_tab(df_plot_rar)

```

## 5. Growth Type Detectability

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# LOAD
# --------------------------------------------------
load("~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.ab_rel_OTU.RData",
  envir = .GlobalEnv)

# --------------------------------------------------
# GROWTH TABLES
# --------------------------------------------------

# By family
tab_fam <- tab_family_growth() %>%
  rename(Clade = family)

# Nourague reference for families %
tab_ref <- tab_family_ref() %>%
  rename(Clade = family) %>%
  rename(REF = total)

# --------------------------------------------------
# DATASET
# --------------------------------------------------

df_list <- list(
  tab_ref,
  df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[2]] %>% rename(GH = Metric),
  df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[4]] %>% rename(ITS = Metric),
  df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[6]] %>% rename(`18S` = Metric),
  df_ab_rel_Richness$Result[[7]] %>% rename(BOTA = Metric),
  tab_fam
)

dataset <- reduce(df_list, full_join, by = "Clade") %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0)

# --------------------------------------------------
# BIAS BY GROWTH TYPE
# --------------------------------------------------

df_bias <- bias_assign(dataset)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

df_bias %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = growth, y = inventory, fill = bias)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(bias, 2)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 1,
    limits = c(0, max(df_bias$bias, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(face = "bold"),
  ) +
  labs(x = "Growth form", y = "Inventory", fill = "Ratio (inv/ref)")

```



# II. SPATIAL PATTERNS

## 1. Correlation tab

### A. Create

#### Un-rarefied

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# --------------------------------------------------

# Rar
rar <- FALSE

# Levels
levels <- c("Species", "Genus", "Family")

# Configurations
config_unrar <- expand.grid(
  "g.Rar" = rar,
  "g.Marker" = c("GH","ITS","18S"),
  "b.Radius" = 10,
  "b.Year" = c(2012),
  "Metric_corr" = c("Count","NCI","MCC"),
  "Level" = levels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Give common Names for each level
level_list <- setNames(
  lapply(levels, function(l) give_common_taxa(Rar = rar, Level = l)),
  levels
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# RUN CALCULS
# --------------------------------------------------
tab_unrar <- make_cor_table_bota_genet(config_unrar, level_list)

# --------------------------------------------------
# VIEW
# --------------------------------------------------
view(tab_unrar)

# --------------------------------------------------
# SAVE
# --------------------------------------------------
save( tab_unrar,
  file = "~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.tab_unrar.RData")

```

## 2. Diversity patterns & Random Forest

### A. Main figure

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# IMPORT DIV PATTERNS
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- BOTA --
bota_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10,
  Metric = "H1",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "All"))

# -- GH -- 
GH_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  "Type"="genet",
  "Rar"=TRUE, 
  "Marker"="GH", 
  "Metric"="H1", 
  "Level"="Species", 
  "Name"="All"))

# -- ITS --
ITS_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  "Type"="genet",
  "Rar"=TRUE, 
  "Marker"="ITS", 
  "Metric"="H1", 
  "Level"="Species", 
  "Name"="All"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# ABIOTIC JOIN
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- ABIOTIC --
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,light,canop12,topo,wetness,Ca,Al,K,C,N) %>%
  mutate(CNratio = C / N) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(C,N))

# -- BOTA --
data_pixel_bota <- inner_join(bota_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# -- GH ---
data_pixel_GH <- inner_join(GH_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# -- ITS ---
data_pixel_ITS <- inner_join(ITS_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# RANDOM FORESTS
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- BOTA --
res_bota <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_bota)

# -- GH ---
res_GH <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_GH)

# -- ITS ---
res_ITS <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_ITS)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

## Patterns
# -- BOTA --
p1 <- plot_grid_interp_soft(bota_H1_grid) +
  labs(title = "(a)", caption = "", fill = "H1") 

# -- GH -- 
p2 <- plot_grid_interp_soft(GH_H1_grid) +
  labs(title = "(b)", caption = "", fill = "H1")

# -- ITS --
p3 <- plot_grid_interp_soft(ITS_H1_grid) + 
  labs(title = "(c)", caption = "", fill = "H1")

## Random Forests
# -- BOTA --
p4 <- res_bota[[1]] +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "(d)")

# -- GH ---
p5 <- res_GH[[1]] +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "(e)")

# -- ITS ---
p6 <- res_ITS[[1]] +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "(f)")

## Patchwork
(p1 | p2 | p3) / (p4 | p5 | p6)

# --------------------------------------------------
# CORRELATIONS
# --------------------------------------------------

cor(bota_H1_grid$df$Metric, GH_H1_grid$df$Metric, method="spearman")
cor(bota_H1_grid$df$Metric, ITS_H1_grid$df$Metric, method="spearman")
cor(GH_H1_grid$df$Metric, ITS_H1_grid$df$Metric, method="spearman")

```

### B. Accumulated Local Effects (ALE)

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# --------------------------------------------------

features <- c("light","canop12","topo","wetness","Ca","Al","K","CNratio")
N_feat <- length(features)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- Bota --
plot_bota_features <- plot_res_by_features(res_bota, features)
p_bota <- wrap_plots(plot_bota_features, ncol = N_feat) +
  plot_annotation(title = "BOTA")

# -- GH --
plot_GH_features <- plot_res_by_features(res_GH, features)
p_GH <- wrap_plots(plot_GH_features, ncol = N_feat) +
  plot_annotation(title = "GH")

# -- ITS --
plot_ITS_features <- plot_res_by_features(res_ITS, features)
p_ITS <- wrap_plots(plot_ITS_features, ncol = N_feat) +
  plot_annotation(title = "ITS")

# --------------------------------------------------
# WRAP
# --------------------------------------------------

wrap_plots(
  p_bota,
  p_GH,
  p_ITS,
  ncol = 1
)

```


### C. Abiotic params correlation

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# IMPORT
# --------------------------------------------------

abiotic_red <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,light,canop12,topo,wetness,Ca,Al,K,C,N) %>%
  mutate(CNratio = C / N) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(C,N,x,y))

# --------------------------------------------------
# CORRELATION MATRIX
# --------------------------------------------------

corr_mat <- cor(abiotic_red, use = "complete.obs")
  
# LONG FORMAT
corr_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(corr_mat))
colnames(corr_df) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Correlation")

# TRIANGLE (upper only)
corr_df <- corr_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.numeric(Var1) <= as.numeric(Var2))

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

ggplot(corr_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(abs(Correlation) > 0.1, # select display corr
                               sprintf("%.2f", Correlation), "")),
            size = 3,
            color = "white",
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B40426",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    fill = "Pearson r"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

```
